entry.title: Fix dedup path silently returning when cached overlay boxes are null
entry.content:
Fix dedup path silently returning when cached overlay boxes are null

When dedup matched but cachedOverlayBoxes was null (e.g. after all
overlays were selectively removed), the code logged the error and
returned without translating. Now it falls through to the full
translate path so overlays are recreated.

entry.title: Fix removed overlays not re-appearing after selective removal
entry.content:
Fix removed overlays not re-appearing after selective removal

After selective overlay removal, lastLiveOcrText still contained the
removed boxes' text. performOcrRecheck's hasSignificantAdditions saw
no "new" characters and returned false — the text was never
re-discovered.

Fix: clear lastLiveOcrText on selective removal so all detected text
is treated as new. Also handle null prevText in performOcrRecheck
by treating all text as new instead of returning false.

Also lower OVERLAY_CHANGE_THRESHOLD from 10% to 5% for testing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

entry.title: Selective overlay removal on Check B instead of full recapture
entry.content:
Selective overlay removal on Check B instead of full recapture

When animation under one overlay triggers Check B, only remove that
overlay and its neighbors (using shared proximity logic) instead of
clearing all overlays and doing a full clean recapture. Remaining
overlays stay on screen with zero flicker.

- overlayDiffPerBox returns which specific boxes triggered
- findNearbyBoxIndices finds neighbors using shared areRectsNearby
- forceCheckC flag ensures next cycle runs fill-and-OCR for the
  exposed areas
- performOcrRecheck proximity check uses shared areRectsNearby
- FILL_PADDING extracted to companion constant

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
